inputs.text: [excited] Seventy-two feet long — as long as two school buses. Standing up, [pauses] forty-three feet tall — as tall as a 4-story building. And forty-seven thousand kilos — [amazed] as heavy as NINE elephants.
[confident] Yep. But here's the thing, [pauses] it's not even the tail that makes it so long: it's the neck, stretched straight up toward the sky.
